items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I put one there by the steps near Duke... Wellman Brand put one of them big firecrackers under my chair

ctx.x: I put one there by the steps near Duke, and when we were on the stage, the show was going on, and I said to Duke, 'What's that smell?' and he said, 'Yeah, something does smell', and gosh, as soon as we got through, he called to the stagehand that a dog or cat must have done something over there, and out came the man with a big shovel, and it was made of plastic, he got the shovel and it went all over the stage. (laughs)

And Wellman Braud and Irving Mills for Christmas she used to get even, on every meal she would give presents to all the older boys, and Wellman Brand put one of them big firecrackers under my chair, and when that thing blew off, whew, I thought I was going to die.
